books.title: Fortress of the Muslim (Hisnul Muslim)
books.author: Said bin Ali Al-Qahtani
books.notes: A comprehensive collection of authentic supplications and remembrances from the Quran and Sunnah, covering all aspects of a Muslim's daily life. One of the most widely read Islamic books worldwide.

books.title: The Sealed Nectar (Ar-Raheeq Al-Makhtum)
books.author: Sheikh Safi-ur-Rahman Al-Mubarakpuri
books.notes: Award-winning biography of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). Winner of first prize in the worldwide Seerah competition held by the Muslim World League in Makkah, 1979.

books.title: Riyad Us Saliheen (Gardens of the Righteous)
books.author: Imam Yahya ibn Sharaf Al-Nawawi
books.notes: One of the most celebrated Hadith collections, compiled by the renowned 13th-century scholar Imam Al-Nawawi. Contains approximately 1900 hadiths focused on ethics, character, and spiritual refinement.

books.title: Hisnul Muslim Urdu — Zubair Ali Edition
books.author: Said bin Ali Al-Qahtani (Tahqeeq: Zubair Ali Zai)
books.notes: Scholarly Urdu edition of Hisnul Muslim with Hadith verification (Tahqeeq) and referencing (Takhreej) by Sheikh Zubair Ali Zai.

books.title: Hisnul Muslim Urdu — Standard Text Edition
books.author: Said bin Ali Al-Qahtani
books.notes: Standard Urdu text edition of the Fortress of the Muslim, presented in clear Urdu.

books.title: An Islamic Philosophy of Virtuous Religions: Introducing Alfarabi
books.author: Joshua Parens
books.notes: A study of Alfarabi's philosophical ideas, virtuous religions, and political philosophy.

books.title: Defining Islamic Comparative Theology
books.author: Idris Nassery and Zishan Ghaffar
books.notes: Explores the foundations and academic scope of Islamic comparative theology.

books.title: God’s Other Book: The Qur’an Between History and Ideology
books.author: Mohammad Salama
books.notes: Examines the Qur’an in relation to history and ideology.

books.title: Islamic Philosophy and Theology: An Extended Survey
books.author: W. Montgomery Watt
books.notes: Provides an overview of Islamic philosophical and theological thought.

books.title: Qur’an Translations in the Eastern Bloc and Beyond
books.author: Elvira Kulieva, Johanna Pink, and Mykhaylo Yakubovych
books.notes: Examines the history and development of Qur’an translations in the Eastern Bloc and beyond.
